question: What is Captio AI and who is it for?
slides: For people who *miss words* in the room.
description: Captio AI is an app for deaf and hard of hearing people that turns what the people around you say into reading on your phone.
Captio AI is made for deaf and hard of hearing people, so reading what is said in the room comes first, not as an add-on to a transcription tool.
According to the World Health Organization, over 5% of the world's population, or 430 million people, require rehabilitation for disabling hearing loss.
The World Health Organization's March 2026 fact sheet projects that by 2050 nearly 2.5 billion people will have some degree of hearing loss.
Captio AI listens through the phone's microphone to people in the same room, for example at a doctor's appointment, a lecture, a shop counter or a dinner table.
Captio AI supports 60 languages on iPhone and Android, and text shows up before the speaker has finished the sentence.
You can download Captio AI free and use the 100 free credits a day on its free plan.
Captio AI needs internet for live use and can make mistakes, so confirm medical instructions with your doctor or pharmacist, and it does not replace an interpreter.
